name: playwright-e2e-framework
description: End-to-end test framework for Sauce Demo built with Playwright and TypeScript
author: Shones Tegang (https://github.com/jokvir)

scripts.test:visual: docker compose run --rm playwright sh -c "npm ci && npm test -- --project=chromium --grep @visual"
scripts.test:visual:update: docker compose run --rm playwright sh -c "npm ci && npm test -- --project=chromium --grep @visual --update-snapshots"
